passages.text: Frequent. Apr; Aug–Oct. Thornhill 131, 132, 148, 170 (NCSC). Specimens seen in the vicinity: Sandy Run [Haw’s Run]: Taggart SARU 16 (WNC!); Sandy Run [Neck]: Wilbur 53682 (DUKE!). [= Myrica cerifera L. var. cerifera sensu RAB; < Myrica cerifera L. sensu FNA; = Weakley]
